brand.name: Oarabile Trading Enterprise (Pty) Ltd
brand.tagline: Built on integrity. Delivered with excellence.
brand.description: Oarabile Trading Enterprise (Pty) Ltd is a Potchefstroom-based, South African construction and project management company providing civil construction, building maintenance, infrastructure works and goods supply and delivery. Established in 2013.
brand.aboutIntro: Established in 2013, Oarabile Trading Enterprise (Pty) Ltd is a privately owned South African company specialising in general construction, civil construction and project management. Our experience spans building work, roads and paving, water and sanitation, renovations and facility upkeep. The company profile describes Oarabile as 100% black-owned and managed.
brand.mission: To build a reputation for integrity, service and diversity — our dependable difference — by managing projects efficiently, coordinating resources responsibly and working to meet and exceed client expectations for quality, cost and time.
brand.vision: To be a preferred provider of programme and project management services across multiple disciplines, building enduring client relationships through integrity, performance, value and satisfaction.

services.name: Building & General Construction
services.summary: New builds, alterations, renovations and structural works for commercial and private clients.

services.name: Civil & Infrastructure Construction
services.summary: Roads, stormwater drainage, paving, kerbing and associated municipal civil works.
services.details: Our profile includes experience with taxi bays, speed humps, pedestrian walkways, infrastructure and roads.

services.name: Building & Facility Maintenance
services.summary: Repairs, upgrades, plumbing, general maintenance and responsive property upkeep.
services.details: Tailor-made maintenance programmes can be planned around the client’s site requirements, schedule and available budget.

services.name: Supply & Delivery of Goods

services.details: Experience stated in the company profile includes day-to-day plumbing work and installation of water tanks.

faqs.question: What construction services do you provide?
faqs.answer: We provide general construction, civil and infrastructure works, building and facility maintenance, water and sanitation, carpentry, paving, security fencing, and related services.

faqs.question: Can you help with supply and delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes. Please share the product description, quantities, delivery location and target date so we can discuss availability and a quotation.

faqs.question: Where are you based?
faqs.answer: Our office is at 1429 Mabuya Street, Ikageng, Potchefstroom, 2531. Other project locations can be discussed according to scope and requirements.

faqs.question: How can I request a quote?
faqs.answer: Complete the enquiry form on the Contact page or contact us on 064 767 9891 or info@oarabiletrading.co.za.
